dedupe_keys.name: supporting data for a service to help insurers understand the financial impacts of changing flood risk in europe peseta iv

description: Supporting data for the Climate Services article "A service to help insurers understand the financial impacts of changing flood risk in Europe, based on PESETA IV" (2023). The Zenodo record, version 1.0 published on 21 May 2023 by Stephen Jewson (Lambda Climate Research), Trevor Maynard and Francesco Dottori, holds two CSV files: betas_mean_std.csv (about 20 KB) and betas_corrs.csv (about 1.1 MB), free to download under the Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0. Keywords are PESETA IV, Europe, flood risk, catastrophe modelling and climate change. The page read does not explain the variables; from the file names and the article title they are means, standard deviations and correlations of 'beta' change factors derived from the European Commission's PESETA IV flood projections, and the article must be read before use. Coverage is Europe. Caveats: the ODbL share-alike terms apply, and the factors depend on the PESETA IV model chain. For simulation it gives a compact way to adjust catastrophe model flood losses in Europe for climate change, including correlation between regions, for insurance portfolio stress tests. A related catalogue record is the COACCH river flood insurance indicators for EU regions.
